environments.1: Late afternoon at the exterior of an ancient rectangular stone gate cut into gray mountain cliffs; simple stone stair forecourt, teal pine mountains, small timber ledger booth on right, warm late daylight. Workaday sect outpost, not an ornate palace.
environments.2: Same gate outpost timber ledger booth: rough wooden counter, paper ledger and bamboo brush, small bronze scale and copper coins; late afternoon. Match prior gate location.
environments.3: Narrow service alley behind the gate ledger booth at sunset, gray stone wall, timber eaves, plain crates, warm/cool daylight separation, no rain.
environments.4: Empty packed-earth training patch behind a modest roadside inn at night, timber fence and one amber paper lantern, cool dark blue sky; poor laborer practicing alone, no spectators.
environments.5: Gate outpost market ledger booth three mornings later, recruitment notice and iron-blue sect banners, clean morning daylight.
environments.6: Steep rocky pine mountain path in clear daylight, gray damp stones and teal-green slopes. Group heading uphill toward stone gate.
environments.7: Ancient torchlit stone corridor before central chamber. Three surviving wall reliefs depict same stone warrior raising sword, descending cut, turning; fourth relief heavily worn away except fixed forward foot. Amber torch and cool blue shadow.

chamber: CANONICAL CHAMBER: one large hexagonal ancient gray-green stone hall, tall square stone columns, stepped low circular altar near north/center with a small brass-bound red-brown rectangular sealed case initially on it. Exactly SIX dormant stone martial guardians initially arranged in an arc north/behind altar: FIVE 2.5-meter carved armored soldiers and ONE central 3.8-meter chief guardian. Chief has a chipped crescent ridge helmet, stern featureless carved stone face, segmented square shoulder armor, broad heavy straight gray stone sword, visible dark wrist pivot gap, massive square feet. All guardians are stone statues, not metal robots or humans; no glowing technology. South main entrance is a descending rectangular stone slab. Narrow maintenance passage is behind broken mural on EAST/right wall and has an iron barred inner door. WEST/left wall has a low recess fitting a seated adult. Cart begins southeast of altar. Cool teal ambient shadows and warm amber torch sconces, crisp illustrated surfaces without photo textures. Keep spatial topology and guardian identities stable. Illustrations may reverse camera view logically but never swap east passage with west shelter. No sunlight sky inside.
style: Modern Korean wuxia webtoon aesthetic matching the style reference: clean confident ink outlines, vivid controlled colors, polished cel shading, sharply readable anatomy and hands, natural adult proportions. No parchment, sepia filter, sketch crosshatch, watercolor, photorealism, 3D, film grain or chibi. One single full-frame 16:9 cinematic still, no panels, collage, grids, caption strips, speech bubbles, lettering, watermark or baked typography. Story text is context, NOT text to draw. All dialogue, SFX and system text will be editable AE layers later. Leave appropriate quiet space near reactions, but do not blank an arbitrary bottom stripe. Do not add aura or magic unless the state explicitly calls for Jangho's blue sword qi. Seojin has NO magical aura or upgraded body in this episode. Draw ONLY the exact requested state, not multiple moments. Preserve character face, clothing, weapon, injury and room continuity. Five correct fingers, coherent sword grip. No extra principal characters.
